metadata.description: A Salesforce-first workspace: plain-English assistants for your deals, accounts, contacts, leads, cases, and to-dos. One plugin per common object, each bundling skills, a specialist agent, and the Salesforce MCP server.

plugins.name: astound-commons
plugins.description: First-run workspace setup (installs the Salesforce dashboards into your Artifacts library) plus shared brand skills: voice, document formatting, client email, company boilerplate, and terminology

plugins.name: astound-salesforce
plugins.description: Your Salesforce assistant: what it can do, how to ask in plain English, and the generalist agent that routes across deals, accounts, contacts, leads, cases, and tasks

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-opportunities
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce opportunities: find deals, read your pipeline and forecast, and safely create and update deals — with a sales pipeline specialist agent

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-accounts
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce accounts: find customers, get a 360° briefing before a call, and safely create and update account records — with an account specialist agent

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-contacts
plugins.description: Work with the people in your Salesforce: find contacts, get briefed on who you know at an account, and safely create and update contact records — with a contacts specialist agent

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-leads
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce leads: find and filter prospects, read your funnel insights, and safely capture and update leads — with a leads specialist agent

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-cases
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce support cases: find cases, read your queue and backlog, and safely create and update cases — with a support case specialist agent

plugins.name: astound-salesforce-activities
plugins.description: Work with your Salesforce activities: find what's due and overdue, read your day and week at a glance, and safely log calls, set follow-ups, and schedule meetings — with a tasks and meetings specialist agent
